khai.tagline: Savoring as process: how a persona attends to and prolongs a positive experience -- turning toward a good moment to make it fuller and last, the mirror of coping -- across the sharpening, sharing, keeping, and dampening ways.

card.wire: Attaches at Process. The root (process_savoring.md) declares savoring as the up-regulation and prolonging of positive experience: not the generating of a good feeling but the tending of it -- the attention and effort that make a pleasure more intense while it lasts and stretch it before and after. The mirror of coping: where coping softens what hurts, savoring heightens and holds what pleases. The law makes a good moment a thing a persona can dwell in and enlarge, or let pass thin.
card.issue: Four ways of savoring, three that amplify and one that kills. Sharpening: narrow attention onto the good and let absorption take over, so a pleasure fully met is a larger pleasure. Sharing: tell someone or let it show, so the good grows in the telling and the witness's answer. Keeping: bank the moment as a memory and feel its transience, stretching the pleasure beyond its instant. Dampening: turn attention against the good -- fault-finding, distraction, kill-joy thinking -- so the positive passes thin and quick, savoring's own failure.
card.require: Two altitudes hold the engine. The law: declared once in the project's Instructions Knowledge chapter, linking the root. The link: each persona links, under Projection, the way of savoring the moment runs -- and therefore whether the good is being intensified, extended, or cut short.
card.enforce: Structure is checked; coherence is judged. The kit verifies the floor: the law is declared and each persona links a real way of savoring. Whether the savoring is true to the scene -- the pleasure genuinely enlarged by the dwelling, or genuinely killed by the killjoy who cannot receive it -- is semantic, taught and reviewed, never failed by the suite.
card.setup: Declare the law in the Instructions Knowledge chapter, linking the root. Then give the persona its way of savoring under Projection. Read it in what the persona does with a good moment -- the full attention paid or withheld, the telling or the swallowing, the snapshot taken, the reflexive undercutting -- never in the emotion itself. Delegate the specific goods heightened (pride, gratitude, awe) to their engines and the neutral machinery of regulating any feeling to the regulation engine.
